```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)

df <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "round-robin-sw"   = "#7db8e8",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "pf-classic-sw"    = "#e8956a",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261",
  "max-weight-sw"    = "#f9c784"
)

BG    <- "#1e1e2e"; PANEL <- "#13131f"
TEXT  <- "#cdd6f4"; AXIS  <- "#a6adc8"; GRID  <- "#2a2a4a"
C_TICKS <- sort(unique(df$C))

EXP_LABELS <- c(
  "capacity_15min"        = "15 min · original",
  "capacity_15min_sw_nsw" = "15 min · sw vs nsw"
)
get_exp_label <- function(e) { l <- EXP_LABELS[[e]]; if (is.null(l)) e else l }

# ── Filtro + gráfico de risco ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
#  Gera um gráfico plotly com filtros interativos (Cenário × K) embutidos via
#  JavaScript. Cada combinação (cenário, K, política) é uma trace separada;
#  o JS atualiza visibility quando o usuário clica nos botões.
#
build_risk_chart <- function(d) {
  pols_exp <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(d$policy))

  # Agrega: (cenário, K, C, política) → risco médio
  df_sc <- d |>
    group_by(scenario, K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(mean_risk = mean(mean_risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # "Todos": média sobre cenários
  df_avg <- df_sc |>
    group_by(K, C, policy) |>
    summarise(mean_risk = mean(mean_risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(scenario = "Todos")

  df_plot   <- bind_rows(df_sc, df_avg)
  scenarios <- c("Todos", sort(unique(df_sc$scenario)))
  k_vals    <- sort(unique(d$K))

  default_sc <- "Todos"
  default_k  <- k_vals[1]

  fig        <- plot_ly()
  trace_meta <- list()
  seen_pols  <- character(0)

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (k in k_vals) {
      for (pol in pols_exp) {
        sub <- filter(df_plot, scenario == sc, K == k, policy == pol)
        if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

        is_default <- sc == default_sc && k == default_k
        first_leg  <- !pol %in% seen_pols
        if (first_leg) seen_pols <- c(seen_pols, pol)

        trace_meta[[length(trace_meta) + 1]] <- list(
          sc  = sc,
          k   = as.integer(k),
          pol = pol
        )

        fig <- add_trace(fig,
          data      = sub,
          x         = ~C,
          y         = ~mean_risk,
          type      = "scatter",
          mode      = "lines+markers",
          name      = pol,
          legendgroup  = pol,
          showlegend   = first_leg,
          visible      = is_default,
          line         = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2.5),
          marker       = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size = 6),
          hovertemplate = paste0(
            "<b>", pol, "</b><br>C = %{x}<br>Risco = %{y:.4g}<extra></extra>"
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  fig <- layout(fig,
    xaxis  = list(
      title      = "Capacidade C (drones simultâneos)",
      color      = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
      tickvals   = C_TICKS, zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis  = list(
      title    = "Risco médio total",
      color    = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL,
    paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font          = list(color = TEXT, size = 11),
    legend        = list(
      font        = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
      bgcolor     = BG,
      title       = list(text = "Política", font = list(color = AXIS, size = 10))
    ),
    margin    = list(l = 70, r = 20, t = 16, b = 55),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  # JavaScript: constrói barra de filtros e gerencia visibility das traces
  js <- "
function(el, data) {
  var meta      = data.meta;
  var scenarios = data.scenarios;
  var kVals     = data.kVals;
  var curSc     = scenarios[0];
  var curK      = kVals[0];

  function updateVis() {
    var vis = meta.map(function(m) { return m.sc === curSc && m.k === curK; });
    Plotly.restyle(el, { visible: vis });
    refreshBtns();
  }

  function refreshBtns() {
    el.parentElement.querySelectorAll('[data-sc]').forEach(function(b) {
      var on = b.dataset.sc === curSc;
      b.style.background = on ? '#378ADD' : '#1a1a2e';
      b.style.color      = on ? '#ffffff' : '#a6adc8';
      b.style.borderColor = on ? '#378ADD' : '#3a3a5a';
    });
    el.parentElement.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(function(b) {
      var on = parseInt(b.dataset.k) === curK;
      b.style.background = on ? '#F4A261' : '#1a1a2e';
      b.style.color      = on ? '#ffffff' : '#a6adc8';
      b.style.borderColor = on ? '#F4A261' : '#3a3a5a';
    });
  }

  function mkBtn(label, active, accent) {
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.textContent = label;
    b.style.cssText =
      'background:' + (active ? accent : '#1a1a2e') + ';' +
      'color:'       + (active ? '#fff' : '#a6adc8') + ';' +
      'border:1px solid ' + (active ? accent : '#3a3a5a') + ';' +
      'border-radius:5px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:11px;' +
      'cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap;';
    return b;
  }

  function mkLabel(txt) {
    var s = document.createElement('span');
    s.textContent = txt;
    s.style.cssText =
      'color:#6a6a8a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;' +
      'text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;align-self:center;';
    return s;
  }

  function mkSep() {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.style.cssText = 'width:1px;background:#2a2a4a;align-self:stretch;margin:0 2px;';
    return d;
  }

  // Barra de filtros
  var bar = document.createElement('div');
  bar.style.cssText =
    'display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;' +
    'padding:9px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;' +
    'background:#0d0d18;border-radius:7px;align-items:center;';

  // Cenário
  bar.appendChild(mkLabel('Cenário'));
  var scGrp = document.createElement('div');
  scGrp.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;';
  scenarios.forEach(function(sc) {
    var btn = mkBtn(sc === 'Todos' ? 'Todos (média)' : sc, sc === curSc, '#378ADD');
    btn.dataset.sc = sc;
    btn.onclick = function() { curSc = sc; updateVis(); };
    scGrp.appendChild(btn);
  });
  bar.appendChild(scGrp);

  bar.appendChild(mkSep());

  // K
  bar.appendChild(mkLabel('K slots/época'));
  var kGrp = document.createElement('div');
  kGrp.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;';
  kVals.forEach(function(k) {
    var btn = mkBtn('K = ' + k, k === curK, '#F4A261');
    btn.dataset.k = k;
    btn.onclick = function() { curK = k; updateVis(); };
    kGrp.appendChild(btn);
  });
  bar.appendChild(kGrp);

  el.parentElement.insertBefore(bar, el);
}
"

  onRender(fig, js, data = list(
    meta      = trace_meta,
    scenarios = scenarios,
    kVals     = as.integer(k_vals)
  ))
}

# ── Monta tabs por experimento ────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_exp_tab <- function(exp_name, exp_df) {
  nav_panel(
    get_exp_label(exp_name),
    div(style = "padding:10px 4px 0;",
      build_risk_chart(exp_df)
    )
  )
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse=", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)` · `r length(unique(df$experiment))` experimentos · `r length(unique(df$policy))` políticas

```{r tabs}
experiments <- unique(df$experiment)
top_panels  <- lapply(experiments, function(e) {
  build_exp_tab(e, filter(df, experiment == e))
})
do.call(navset_tab, c(top_panels, list(id = "exp_tabs")))
```
